steps.en: Install the Community edition (installer, ZIP or snap); a Java runtime is bundled
steps.zh: 装上社区版（安装包、ZIP 或 snap），自带 Java 运行时

steps.en: Create a connection: pick the database type, enter host and credentials, test and save
steps.zh: 新建连接：选数据库类型，填主机和账号，测试后保存

steps.en: Fetches the JDBC driver if it is not bundled, then loads the schema into the Connections tree
steps.zh: 驱动没打包就自动下载，再把库表结构读进连接树

steps.en: Open an SQL editor on the connection and run queries, or open a table's data
steps.zh: 在连接上打开 SQL 编辑器跑查询，或者直接打开表数据

steps.en: Shows results in an editable grid and keeps your row edits pending
steps.zh: 把结果放进可编辑表格，先把你改的行记为待提交

steps.en: On Save, applies the added, changed and deleted rows to the database
steps.zh: 点保存时，把新增、修改、删除的行写回数据库

value.en: One desktop app browses, queries and edits 100+ databases instead of one native client per engine
value.zh: 一个桌面应用就能浏览、查询、编辑 100 多种数据库，不用每种库装一个客户端

sources: https://github.com/dbeaver/dbeaver/wiki/Create-Connection (test the connection and save it; Connections tree)
https://github.com/dbeaver/dbeaver/wiki/SQL-Editor (Ctrl+Enter in the Connections view opens the SQL editor)
https://github.com/dbeaver/dbeaver/wiki/Data-Editor (Save applies added, duplicated, deleted rows and inline edits)
